_comment: Build-time plugin selection. The browser shell is CORE and always present. Remove an id from `enabled` (or set the BRO_PLUGINS env var to a comma-separated list, which overrides this file) to EXCLUDE that feature from the build — its code is then not imported and gets tree-shaken out. `dependsOn` is enforced by esbuild.mjs: enabling a plugin without its dependencies fails the build. See PLUGINS.md for the full catalog.
